description.value: Kalvas The Loghouse Restaurant is an upscale fine-dining destination in Parksville housed in a distinctive log building, specializing in prime-grade steaks and fresh Pacific Northwest seafood including wild sockeye salmon, halibut, and Dungeness crab. Its circular dining room and European-influenced menu — featuring dishes like schnitzel, escargot, and oysters Rockefeller alongside an extensive BC wine cellar — make it a notable splurge for touring cyclists passing through the Parksville area. The restaurant also offers phone-ahead pickup for those wanting a quality meal on the go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kalvastheloghouse.com is live, detailed, and confirms a real operating restaurant at 180 Moilliet Street, Parksville. A critical name mismatch exists: OSM records 'Kavalas' but the website consistently uses 'Kalvas The Loghouse Restaurant' — the OSM-linked URL itself spells it 'kalvas', strongly suggesting a typo in the OSM name field. The website confirms takeout/pickup via 'Call for reservation and pick-up (250) 248-6933', and no information about bike parking, washrooms, or cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the name as 'Kavalas' but the business website, domain, and all branding consistently use 'Kalvas The Loghouse Restaurant' / 'Kalvas The Log House'. The OSM-provided URL (kalvastheloghouse.com) itself spells it 'kalvas', strongly indicating a typo in the OSM name field. OSM name should be corrected to 'Kalvas'.
Address discrepancy: OSM lists '180 Moilliet Street North' but the website uses '180 Moilliet Street' (no 'North'). Website value used.
OSM has no phone number; phone sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible fine-dining restaurant with a live website, confirmed phone number, and clear menu. A legitimate stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal in Parksville.
